## Context

Before any change-size/decomposition rule can enter the DET floor, measure whether change shape actually drives the defect-rework loop here (11-plan-v3 I-4; measurement-first matches the field: Prow's size/* labels are non-blocking — 12c). Tooling anchor (12a): extend scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py (442 lines; imports the shipped threshold predicate so it cannot drift), and check overlap with the Tier-2 replay harness (ADR 0109) first. 2026 grounding (12b): MSR'26 agentic-PR studies show files-touched/commit fragmentation is a sharper variable than raw LOC, and the size-quality relationship is nonstationary; context-fragmentation is an independent causal variable (39% quality drop in a controlled study). The two doubling friction categories (CI-at-landing regressions 25/60; environment 13/60 — R2S3) are unexplained and get mechanism reads, not guesses.

## Approach

Three reads, published under reports/stability/: (a) extend the backtest to all work (not just bugs): rework/negative-vote/regression rate vs non-test LOC, files touched, and commit fragmentation; (b) mechanism-read 20 CI-at-landing regressions from the doubling window — for each: what failed, change shape, cross-session interference?, isolation class?, drift class?; (c) mechanism-read the environment-failure session reports — worktree provisioning, dependency drift, the hourly global-install tracker. Then record the enforcement decision (size/decomposition DET rule: yes with threshold + re-tune cadence, or no with reason) in the decisions index either way.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1: reports/stability/change-shape-backtest.md with the three variables' distributions and rework correlations, method stated, reproducible via the extended script.
- [ ] AC2: reports/stability/ci-landing-regressions-read.md with a per-case table (20 cases: mechanism, change shape, class).
- [ ] AC3: reports/stability/environment-failures-read.md with per-case mechanisms and the class dispositions feeding the doctor-checks scope.
- [ ] AC4: the enforcement decision recorded (either way) with its evidence, in the decisions index/ADR per the program's B-3 convention.

## File impact

- scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py (extend: all-work mode + files-touched/fragmentation variables)
- reports/stability/change-shape-backtest.md, ci-landing-regressions-read.md, environment-failures-read.md (new reports)
